title: Learning Force-Reactive Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.35862v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many everyday tasks require controlling contact force as well as motion. On a humanoid, this force must often be coordinated across both hands and the whole body, and cannot be specified by kinematic trajectories alone. Therefore, we present FLORE, a framework for learning force-reactive humanoid loco-manipulation. We collect robot-free demonstrations using two force-sensing UMI-style handheld grippers for hand motion and contact wrenches, and wearable trackers for body motion. A force-reactive diffusion policy takes vision, proprioception, and measured wrenches as input, then predicts actions and per-hand force commands. A hybrid compliance whole-body controller with force tracking executes these commands while maintaining balance: an integral of the force error measured by real force/torque (F/T) sensors lets each hand track force accurately along the commanded direction and remain compliant along the others. translated_title: 学习力响应的人形机器人移动操作
translated_abstract: 许多日常任务不仅需要控制运动，还需要控制接触力。对于人形机器人而言，这种力往往需要在双手与全身之间进行协调，且无法仅通过运动学轨迹来指定。因此，我们提出了 FLORE，一个用于学习力响应的人形机器人移动操作框架。我们使用两个具备力感知的 UMI 式手持夹爪（采集手部运动和接触力旋量）以及可穿戴追踪器（采集身体运动）来收集无需机器人的演示数据。力响应扩散策略以视觉、本体感觉和测得的力旋量为输入，预测动作以及每只手的力指令。带有力跟踪的混合柔顺全身控制器在保持平衡的同时执行这些指令：通过对真实力/力矩（F/T）传感器测得的力误差进行积分，使每只手能够沿指令方向精确跟踪力，并沿其他方向保持柔顺。在仿真中，该（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出 FLORE 框架，结合力响应扩散策略与带力跟踪的混合柔顺全身控制器，实现人形机器人双手与全身协调的力控制移动操作。
en_tdlr: FLORE is a framework that learns force-reactive humanoid loco-manipulation through a force-reactive diffusion policy and a hybrid compliance whole-body controller with accurate per-hand force tracking.
